name: apiforge-monorepo
description: APIForge — AI-Powered API Behavior Verification & Debugging Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test:cli: node --test cli/test/environments.test.js cli/test/import.test.js cli/test/output.test.js cli/test/run.test.js cli/test/suite.test.js cli/test/variables.test.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

author: APIForge Team
